translations.literal: Zhiren hastily joined Recorder Shan Siren, Instructor Wu Fenglai, and Assistant Instructor Lu Dashou in directing the people to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiren hastily joined Recorder Shan Siren, Instructor Wu Fenglai, and Assistant Instructor Lu Dashou in organizing the townspeople to defend the city.

sentences.zh: 城陷，誌仁持長矛巷戰，殺六賊。

translations.literal: When the city fell, Zhiren fought in the alleys with a long spear and killed six bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Zhiren fought through the streets with a long spear and killed six bandits.

sentences.zh: 力屈被縶，抑使跪。

translations.literal: His strength exhausted, he was bound and forced to kneel.
translations.idiomatic: Exhausted, he was seized and forced to his knees.

sentences.zh: 罵曰：「我天子命官，肯屈膝賊輩邪！」

translations.literal: He cursed: I am an official appointed by the Son of Heaven—would I kneel before bandits!
translations.idiomatic: He cursed them, "I am an official appointed by the Son of Heaven—would I kneel before bandits!

sentences.zh: 賊怒，碎其支體，焚之。

translations.literal: The bandits, enraged, smashed his limbs and burned him.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, the bandits shattered his limbs and burned him alive.

sentences.zh: 妻唐被逼，大罵，奪賊刀不得，口嚙賊手，遂遇害。

translations.literal: His wife Tang, pressed hard, cursed loudly; unable to seize a bandit's knife, she bit a bandit's hand with her mouth and was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: His wife, née Tang, was seized and cursed them fiercely; failing to wrest a bandit's knife from him, she bit his hand and was killed.

sentences.zh: 思仁等亦不屈死。

translations.literal: Siren and the others likewise refused to submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: Siren and the others likewise refused to yield and died.

sentences.zh: 汝才在英山，聞之，馳至羅田，斬其別校，曰：「奈何擅害長者！」

translations.literal: Rucai was at Yingshan; hearing of it, he rushed to Luotian, beheaded his subordinate commander, and said: How dare you murder a man of worth on your own authority!
translations.idiomatic: Rucai was at Yingshan; when he heard what had happened, he raced to Luotian, beheaded his subordinate commander, and said, "How dare you kill a worthy man on your own authority!

sentences.zh: 以錦繡斂其夫婦屍。

translations.literal: He wrapped their corpses in brocade for burial.
translations.idiomatic: He had their bodies wrapped in brocade for burial.

sentences.zh: 鳳來，福建舉人。

translations.literal: Fenglai was a Fujian provincial graduate.
translations.idiomatic: Fenglai was a provincial graduate from Fujian.

sentences.zh: 大受，寶慶貢生。

translations.literal: Dashou was a tribute student from Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou was a tribute student from Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 詔贈誌仁蘄州知州，思仁羅田主簿，鳳來國子助教，大受學錄，蔭子，祭葬有差。

translations.literal: By edict Zhiren was posthumously made magistrate of Qizhou, Siren registrar of Luotian, Fenglai Assistant Instructor of the Directorate of Education, Dashou Recorder of the Directorate of Education; sons were granted privilege, and sacrificial and funeral rites were granted according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial edict Zhiren was posthumously made magistrate of Qizhou, Siren registrar of Luotian, Fenglai Assistant Instructor of the Directorate of Education, and Dashou Recorder of the Directorate of Education; their sons received hereditary privilege, and sacrificial and funeral honors were granted according to rank.

sentences.zh: 王國訓，字振之，解州人。

translations.literal: Wang Guoxun, courtesy name Zhenzhi, was a native of Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Guoxun, whose courtesy name was Zhenzhi, was from Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年進士。

translations.literal: A metropolitan graduate in the second year of Tianqi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the second year of Tianqi.

sentences.zh: 歷知金鄉、壽張、滋陽、武清。

translations.literal: He successively served as magistrate of Jinxiang, Shouzhang, Ziyang, and Wuqing.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as magistrate of Jinxiang, Shouzhang, Ziyang, and Wuqing.

sentences.zh: 坐大計，久之，補調扶風。

translations.literal: He was dismissed at the triennial evaluation; after a long time he was reassigned to Fufeng.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissed at the triennial evaluation, he was eventually reassigned to Fufeng.

sentences.zh: 國訓性剛嚴，恥幹進，故官久不遷。

translations.literal: Guoxun was by nature stern and severe, ashamed of pushing for advancement, and so long went without promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Guoxun was stern and upright by nature and ashamed of currying favor for advancement, and so long remained without promotion.

sentences.zh: 崇禎八年秋，賊來犯，偕主簿夏建忠、典史陳紹南、教諭張弘綱、訓導陳繻嬰城固守。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighth year of Chongzhen bandits came to attack; he joined Registrar Xia Jianzhong, Recorder Chen Shaonan, Instructor Zhang Honggang, and Assistant Instructor Chen Xu in sealing the city and holding firm.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighth year of Chongzhen, when bandits attacked, he joined Registrar Xia Jianzhong, Recorder Chen Shaonan, Instructor Zhang Honggang, and Assistant Instructor Chen Xu in sealing the city and holding firm.

sentences.zh: 閱兩月，外援不至，城陷，罵賊死。

translations.literal: After two months relief did not arrive; the city fell and he cursed the bandits and died.
translations.idiomatic: After two months with no relief, the city fell; he cursed the bandits and died.

sentences.zh: 建忠等亦不屈死。

translations.literal: Jianzhong and the others likewise refused to submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: Jianzhong and the others likewise refused to yield and died.

sentences.zh: 贈國訓光祿少卿，建忠等皆贈恤。

translations.literal: Guoxun was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Jianzhong and the others all received posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: Guoxun was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Jianzhong and the others all received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 當是時，大帥曹文詔、艾萬年等並戰歿，賊勢益張，關中諸州縣悉殘破。

translations.literal: At that time Grand Commander Cao Wenzhao, Ai Wannian, and others all died in battle; bandit power grew more rampant, and all prefectures and counties in Guanzhong were ravaged.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Grand Commander Cao Wenzhao, Ai Wannian, and others had all fallen in battle; the bandits grew stronger, and prefectures and counties throughout Guanzhong were laid waste.

sentences.zh: 八月，賊陷永壽，殺知縣薄匡宇。

translations.literal: In the eighth month bandits took Yongshou and killed Magistrate Bo Kuangyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the bandits took Yongshou and killed Magistrate Bo Kuangyu.

sentences.zh: 尋陷咸陽，殺知縣趙躋昌。

translations.literal: Soon afterward they took Xianyang and killed Magistrate Zhao Jichang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward they took Xianyang and killed Magistrate Zhao Jichang.

sentences.zh: 其時長吏以死聞者，隴州知州胡爾純，自經死。

translations.literal: At that time among senior officials reported dead in office was Longzhou Prefect Hu Erchun, who hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Among the senior officials reported dead at that time was Longzhou Prefect Hu Erchun, who hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 延長知縣萬代芳與教諭譚恩、驛丞羅文魁協力守城，城陷皆死之。

translations.literal: Yanchang Magistrate Wan Daifang, Instructor Tan En, and post station assistant Luo Wenkuai jointly defended the city; when it fell they all died.
translations.idiomatic: Yanchang Magistrate Wan Daifang, Instructor Tan En, and post station assistant Luo Wenkuai worked together to defend the city; when it fell, they all perished.

sentences.zh: 代芳妻劉、妾梁從死。

translations.literal: Daifang's wife Liu and concubine Liang followed him in death.
translations.idiomatic: Daifang's wife, née Liu, and his concubine, née Liang, died with him.

sentences.zh: 爾純，山東人，贈光祿少卿。

translations.literal: Erchun was a Shandong man; he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Erchun was from Shandong and was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 代芳贈光祿丞，妻妾建坊旌表。

translations.literal: Daifang was posthumously made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; his wife and concubine were honored with a commemorative arch.
translations.idiomatic: Daifang was posthumously made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and his wife and concubine were honored with a commemorative arch.

sentences.zh: 恩等亦賜祭。

translations.literal: En and the others also received sacrificial honors.
translations.idiomatic: En and the others also received sacrificial honors.

sentences.zh: 有孫仲嗣者，膚施人，由貢生為階州學正。

translations.literal: There was one Sun Zhongsi, a native of Fushi, who through tribute student rank became Director of Studies of Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: There was a man named Sun Zhongsi from Fushi who, through the tribute student route, became Director of Studies at Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 當事知其才，委以城守。

translations.literal: Those in charge knew his talent and entrusted him with the city's defense.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities recognized his ability and put him in charge of defending the city.

sentences.zh: 賊大至，盡瘁死守。

translations.literal: When bandits came in force, he exhausted himself in a death-defying defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits arrived in force, he threw himself into the defense with all his strength.

sentences.zh: 城破，與妻子十余人並死之。

translations.literal: When the city was broken, he and more than ten members of his family died together.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, he and more than ten members of his family died together.

sentences.zh: 贈國子博士。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Doctor of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Doctor of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 又有楊呈秀，華陰人。

translations.literal: There was also Yang Chengxiu, a native of Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Yang Chengxiu, from Huayin.

sentences.zh: 由進士歷官順慶知府，大計罷歸。

translations.literal: A metropolitan graduate, he rose to prefect of Shunqing; dismissed at the triennial evaluation, he returned home.
translations.idiomatic: A metropolitan graduate, he had served as prefect of Shunqing before being dismissed at the triennial evaluation and returning home.

sentences.zh: 賊攻城，佐有司禦賊以死，贈恤如制。

translations.literal: When bandits attacked the city, he assisted the officials in resisting the bandits and died; posthumous honors were granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits attacked the city, he assisted the officials in resisting them and died; he received posthumous honors according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 黎弘業，字孟擴，順德人。

translations.literal: Li Hongye, courtesy name Mengkuo, was a native of Shunde.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongye, whose courtesy name was Mengkuo, was from Shunde.

sentences.zh: 由舉人知和州。

translations.literal: A provincial graduate, he served as prefect of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate, he served as prefect of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 崇禎八年，流賊犯和州，禦卻之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Chongzhen roving bandits attacked Hezhou; he repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Chongzhen, roving bandits attacked Hezhou and he drove them off.

sentences.zh: 十二月復至，與鄉官馬如蛟募死士，登陴固守。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they returned; with local official Ma Rujiao he recruited dare-to-die warriors and mounted the walls to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: They returned in the twelfth month; together with local official Ma Rujiao he recruited die-hard fighters and mounted the walls to hold firm.

sentences.zh: 城將陷，弘業系印於肘，跪告其母曰：「兒不肖，貪微官以累母，奈何！」

translations.literal: As the city was about to fall, Hongye tied his seal to his elbow, knelt and told his mother: Your son is unworthy; coveting a petty office I have brought trouble upon you—what is to be done!
translations.idiomatic: As the city was about to fall, Hongye tied his official seal to his arm, knelt before his mother, and said, "Your son is unworthy; in clinging to a petty office I have brought calamity upon you—what can be done!

sentences.zh: 母李泣諭曰：「汝勿以我為意，事至此，有死而已。」

translations.literal: His mother Li wept and counselled him: Do not take me into account; matters have come to this—there is only death.
translations.idiomatic: His mother, née Li, wept and urged him, "Do not worry about me; it has come to this—there is nothing left but death."

sentences.zh: 遂自縊。

translations.literal: She then hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: She then hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 妻楊、妾李及女四人繼之。

translations.literal: His wife Yang, concubine Li, and four daughters followed after her.
translations.idiomatic: His wife, née Yang, his concubine, née Li, and four daughters followed her in death.

sentences.zh: 弘業北面慟哭再拜，自刎未殊，濡頸血大書曰：「為臣盡忠，為子盡孝，何惜一死。」

translations.literal: Hongye faced north, wept bitterly, and bowed twice; he cut his own throat but was not yet dead; soaking the blood from his neck he wrote in large characters: As a minister I have done my utmost in loyalty, as a son my utmost in filial piety—what is one death to regret?
translations.idiomatic: Hongye turned north, wept in grief, and bowed twice; he tried to cut his own throat but did not die at once; smearing the blood from his neck, he wrote in large characters, "I have done my utmost in loyalty as a minister and in filial piety as a son—why should I regret one death?

sentences.zh: 賊入，傷數刃而死。

translations.literal: When bandits entered, he was wounded by several blades and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits entered, he was cut down by several blades and died.

sentences.zh: 贈太仆少卿，任一子。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and one son was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and one son was granted an official post.

sentences.zh: 判官錢大用偕妻妾子婦俱死。

translations.literal: Assistant Prefect Qian Dayong died together with his wife, concubines, daughters-in-law, and sons' wives.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Prefect Qian Dayong died together with his wife, concubines, daughters-in-law, and sons' wives.

sentences.zh: 吏目景一高被創死。

translations.literal: Clerk Jing Yigao was wounded and died.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Jing Yigao was wounded and died.

sentences.zh: 學正康正諫，祁門人，舉人。

translations.literal: Director of Studies Kang Zhengjian was a Qimen native and provincial graduate.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Studies Kang Zhengjian was from Qimen and a provincial graduate.

sentences.zh: 偕妻汪、子婦章赴水死，贈國子監丞。

translations.literal: Together with his wife Wang and daughter-in-law Zhang he drowned himself; he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He drowned himself together with his wife, née Wang, and his daughter-in-law, née Zhang, and was posthumously made Vice Director of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 訓導趙世選不屈死，贈國子學錄。

translations.literal: Assistant Instructor Zhao Shixuan refused to submit and died; he was posthumously made Recorder of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Instructor Zhao Shixuan refused to yield and died; he was posthumously made Recorder of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 馬如蛟，字騰仲，州人。

translations.literal: Ma Rujiao, courtesy name Tengzhong, was a native of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Rujiao, whose courtesy name was Tengzhong, was a native of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年進士。

translations.literal: A metropolitan graduate in the second year of Tianqi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the second year of Tianqi.

sentences.zh: 授浙江山陰知縣，有清操。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Shanyin in Zhejiang, he had pure integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed magistrate of Shanyin in Zhejiang, he was known for his incorruptible conduct.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年征授御史，劾罷魏忠賢黨徐紹吉、張訥。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongzhen he was summoned and appointed censor; he impeached and had removed Xu Shaoji and Zhang Ne, partisans of Wei Zhongxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongzhen he was recalled and appointed censor; he impeached and brought about the dismissal of Xu Shaoji and Zhang Ne, members of Wei Zhongxian's faction.

sentences.zh: 出按四川，蜀中奸民悉以他人田產投勢家，如蛟列上十事，永革其弊。

translations.literal: Sent out to inspect Sichuan, he found that scoundrels in Shu all transferred others' landholdings to powerful families; Rujiao listed ten measures and permanently abolished this abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to inspect Sichuan, he found that throughout Shu scoundrels were registering others' lands in the names of powerful families; Rujiao submitted ten proposals and permanently abolished the practice.

sentences.zh: 還朝，監武會試。

translations.literal: Returning to court, he supervised the military metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to court, he supervised the military metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 武舉董姓者，以技勇聞於帝，及入試，文不中程，被黜。

translations.literal: A military licentiate surnamed Dong, whose skill and valor were known to the emperor, entered the examination but his written work did not meet standard and he was failed.
translations.idiomatic: A military licentiate surnamed Dong, whose martial skill was well known to the emperor, failed the written portion of the examination and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，黜考官，如蛟亦落職。

translations.literal: The emperor was enraged, dismissed the examiners, and Rujiao also lost his post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged, dismissed the examiners, and Rujiao lost his post as well.

sentences.zh: 八年論平邦彥功，復故官，以父憂未赴。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, in recognition of merit in pacifying An Bangyan, his former office was restored, but he did not take it up due to mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year his former office was restored in recognition of his merit in pacifying An Bangyan, but he did not take it up because he was in mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 流賊至，如蛟傾貲募士，佐弘業固守。

translations.literal: When roving bandits arrived, Rujiao spent all his wealth to recruit men and assisted Hongye in holding firm.
translations.idiomatic: When roving bandits arrived, Rujiao spent his entire fortune to recruit troops and helped Hongye hold the city.

sentences.zh: 麾壯士出擊，兩戰皆捷。

translations.literal: He commanded brave men to sally forth and attack; both battles were victorious.
translations.idiomatic: He led brave men out to attack; both engagements were won.

sentences.zh: 賊將奔，會風雪大作，不辨人色，守者皆潰，賊遂入城。

translations.literal: The bandits were about to flee when a great snowstorm arose and faces could not be distinguished; the defenders all broke, and the bandits entered the city.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were about to flee when a blizzard struck and no one could tell friend from foe; the defenders all scattered, and the bandits entered the city.

sentences.zh: 如蛟急下令，能擊賊者，予百金，須臾得百余人。

translations.literal: Rujiao urgently issued an order that whoever could strike a bandit would receive a hundred taels of gold; in a moment more than a hundred men were gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Rujiao urgently promised a hundred taels of gold to anyone who could strike down a bandit; within moments he had gathered more than a hundred men.

sentences.zh: 巷戰，賊多傷，力屈，遂戰死。

translations.literal: Fighting in the alleys, many bandits were wounded; his strength exhausted, he died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting through the streets, they wounded many bandits; exhausted at last, he died in battle.

sentences.zh: 兄鹽運司判官如虬、諸生如虹及家屬十四人皆死。

translations.literal: His elder brother, Salt Transport Assistant Prefect Ma Ruqiu, student Ma Ruhong, and fourteen family members all died.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother, Salt Transport Assistant Prefect Ma Ruqiu, his brother the student Ma Ruhong, and fourteen family members all died.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太仆少卿，官一子。

translations.literal: When the affair was reported, he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and one son was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and one son was granted an official post.

sentences.zh: 張紹登，字振夫，南城人。

translations.literal: Zhang Shaodeng, courtesy name Zhenfu, was a native of Nancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shaodeng, whose courtesy name was Zhenfu, was from Nancheng.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中舉人，知應城縣。

translations.literal: A provincial graduate in the Chongzhen reign, he served as magistrate of Yingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate in the Chongzhen reign, he served as magistrate of Yingcheng.

sentences.zh: 九年，賊來犯，偕訓導張國勛、鄉官饒可久悉力禦之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year bandits came to attack; he joined Assistant Instructor Zhang Guoxun and local official Rao Kejiu in resisting with all their strength.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year bandits attacked; he joined Assistant Instructor Zhang Guoxun and local official Rao Kejiu in resisting with all their strength.

sentences.zh: 國勛曰：「賊不一創，城不易守。」

translations.literal: Guoxun said: Unless the bandits are struck a blow, the city will not be easy to hold.
translations.idiomatic: Guoxun said, "Unless the bandits are struck a hard blow, the city will not be easy to hold.

sentences.zh: 率壯士出擊，力戰一日夜，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: He led brave men out to attack; fighting hard for a day and a night, they beheaded and captured a great many.
translations.idiomatic: He led brave men out to attack; after fighting hard for a day and a night, they beheaded and captured a great many.

sentences.zh: 賊去，邑侍郎王瑊之子權結怨於族黨，怨家潛導賊復來攻。

translations.literal: The bandits left; Quan, son of Vice Minister Wang Jian of the town, had forged enmity with his clan associates, and an enemy family secretly guided the bandits to come attack again.
translations.idiomatic: After the bandits withdrew, Quan, son of Vice Minister Wang Jian of the town, had made enemies among his clansmen; an enemy family secretly led the bandits back to attack.

sentences.zh: 國勛佐紹登力守，而乞援於上官。

translations.literal: Guoxun assisted Shaodeng in defending with all their strength, and begged for relief from superiors.
translations.idiomatic: Guoxun assisted Shaodeng in holding the city with all their strength and pleaded for reinforcements from their superiors.

sentences.zh: 副將鄧祖禹來救，守西南，國勛守東北，紹登往來策應。

translations.literal: Deputy General Deng Zuyu came to rescue; he defended the southwest, Guoxun defended the northeast, and Shaodeng moved back and forth coordinating the response.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy General Deng Zuyu came to the rescue, holding the southwest while Guoxun held the northeast and Shaodeng moved between them to coordinate the defense.

sentences.zh: 會賊射書索權，權懼，斬北關以出，賊乘間登南城。

translations.literal: At that time the bandits shot in a letter demanding Quan; Quan was afraid, cut down the north gate to flee, and the bandits seized the opportunity to climb onto the south wall.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits then shot in a message demanding Quan; terrified, he hacked through the north gate to escape, and the bandits seized the moment to scale the south wall.

sentences.zh: 紹登還署，端坐堂上，賊至，奮拳擊之。

translations.literal: Shaodeng returned to the yamen, sat upright in the hall; when the bandits arrived, he struck them with his fists.
translations.idiomatic: Shaodeng returned to the yamen and sat upright in the hall; when the bandits arrived, he struck at them with his bare fists.

sentences.zh: 群賊大至，乃被殺。

translations.literal: When a large force of bandits arrived, he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: When a great swarm of bandits arrived, he was killed.

sentences.zh: 賊渠嘆其忠，以冠帶覆屍，埋堂側。

translations.literal: The bandit chieftain sighed at his loyalty, covered the corpse with cap and sash, and buried him beside the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chieftain sighed at his loyalty, covered the body with cap and sash, and buried him beside the hall.

sentences.zh: 國勛，黃陂歲貢生。

translations.literal: Guoxun was an annual tribute student from Huangpi.
translations.idiomatic: Guoxun was an annual tribute student from Huangpi.

sentences.zh: 賊既入，朝服北面拜，走捧先聖神主，拱立以待。

translations.literal: When the bandits had entered, he put on court dress and bowed facing north, then ran to embrace the spirit tablets of the Sage, standing with hands clasped waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Once the bandits had entered, he donned court dress and bowed facing north, then ran to take up the spirit tablets of the Sage and stood with clasped hands awaiting his fate.

sentences.zh: 賊遂焚文廟，投國勛於烈焰中。

translations.literal: The bandits then burned the Confucian temple and threw Guoxun into the flames.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits then burned the Confucian temple and cast Guoxun into the flames.

sentences.zh: 祖禹亦不屈死。

translations.literal: Zuyu also died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Zuyu likewise died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 可久，幼孤，事母孝，舉於鄉。

translations.literal: Kejiu was orphaned young, served his mother filially, and passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: Kejiu lost his father in childhood, served his mother with filial devotion, and passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 知大興縣。

translations.literal: He served as magistrate of Daxing County.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate of Daxing County.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初，疏請更《三朝要典》，時奄宦擅權，謫光祿典簿。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongzhen, he memorialized requesting revision of the Three Reigns Essential Records; at the time eunuchs monopolized power, and he was demoted to Record Clerk of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Chongzhen reign, he memorialized requesting revision of the Three Reigns Essential Records; eunuchs then monopolized power, and he was demoted to Record Clerk of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 遷應天府推官、刑部主事，歷知府，丁艱歸。

translations.literal: He was transferred to investigating censor of Yingtian Prefecture and principal secretary in the Ministry of Justice, successively served as prefect, and returned home upon mourning his parent's death.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to investigating censor of Yingtian Prefecture and principal secretary in the Ministry of Justice, rose through posts as prefect, and returned home to mourn his parent's death.

sentences.zh: 賊入，語妻程曰：「臣死忠，婦死節，分也。」

translations.literal: When bandits entered, he told his wife Cheng: A minister dies in loyalty, a wife dies in chastity — such is one's allotted duty.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits entered, he told his wife Cheng, "A minister dies in loyalty, a wife dies in chastity — such is our allotted duty.

sentences.zh: 於是妻女相對自經。

translations.literal: Thereupon wife and daughter hanged themselves facing each other.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon his wife and daughter hanged themselves facing each other.

sentences.zh: 可久被執，賊強之拜，曰：「頭可斷，膝不可屈也！」

translations.literal: Kejiu was seized; the bandits forced him to bow; he said: My head may be cut off, but my knees will not bend!
translations.idiomatic: Kejiu was seized, and the bandits forced him to bow; he cried, "My head may be cut off, but my knees will not bend!

sentences.zh: 遂遇害。

translations.literal: He was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: He was then killed.

sentences.zh: 瑊為賊支解。

translations.literal: Jian was dismembered by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Jian was dismembered by the bandits.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈紹登尚寶少卿，國勛國子學正。

translations.literal: When the affair was reported, Shaodeng was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Seals, and Guoxun was made Instructor of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, Shaodeng was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Seals, and Guoxun was made Instructor of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 王燾，字浚仲，昆山人。

translations.literal: Wang Tao, courtesy name Junzhong, was a native of Kunshan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tao, whose courtesy name was Junzhong, was from Kunshan.

sentences.zh: 少孤貧，九歲為人後。

translations.literal: Orphaned and poor in youth, at nine he was adopted as another's heir.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned and poor in childhood, at nine he was adopted as another family's heir.

sentences.zh: 族人有謀其產者，燾舉以讓之，迎養嗣祖母及母惟謹。

translations.literal: When a clansman plotted to seize his property, Tao yielded it entirely; he received and cared for his adoptive grandmother and mother with utmost diligence.
translations.idiomatic: When a clansman plotted to seize his property, Tao yielded it entirely; he received and cared for his adoptive grandmother and mother with the utmost diligence.

sentences.zh: 萬歷末，舉於鄉，由教諭歷隨州知州。

translations.literal: At the end of Wanli he passed the provincial examination; from instructor he rose to prefect of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Wanli reign he passed the provincial examination; from instructor he rose to prefect of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 州經群盜焚掠，戶不滿千。

translations.literal: The prefecture had been burned and plundered by bandits; households numbered fewer than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had been burned and plundered by bandits, and households numbered fewer than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 燾訓民兵，繕守具。

translations.literal: Tao trained the militia and repaired defensive equipment.
translations.idiomatic: Tao trained the militia and repaired the city's defenses.

sentences.zh: 土寇李良喬為亂，殲滅之。

translations.literal: Local bandit Li Liangqiao rebelled; Tao annihilated him.
translations.idiomatic: When the local bandit Li Liangqiao rebelled, Tao annihilated him.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，大賊奄至。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year, large bandit forces suddenly arrived.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year, a great bandit army suddenly arrived.

sentences.zh: 燾且守且戰，擊斬三百余人。

translations.literal: Tao both defended and fought, striking down and beheading more than three hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Tao both defended and fought, killing and beheading more than three hundred men.

sentences.zh: 賊攻益力，相持二十余日。

translations.literal: The bandits pressed the attack with increasing force; they held out for more than twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits pressed their attack ever harder, and the two sides held out against each other for more than twenty days.

sentences.zh: 天大風雪，守者多散。

translations.literal: Heaven sent a great wind and snow; many defenders scattered.
translations.idiomatic: A great wind and snowstorm struck, and many defenders scattered.

sentences.zh: 燾知必敗，入署，整冠帶自經。

translations.literal: Tao knew defeat was inevitable; he entered the yamen, straightened his cap and sash, and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing defeat was inevitable, Tao entered the yamen, straightened his cap and sash, and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 賊焚其署，火燭不及燾死所，屍直立不仆，賊望見駭走。

translations.literal: The bandits burned his yamen; the flames did not reach where Tao had died; his corpse stood upright without falling; bandits who saw it fled in terror.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits burned his yamen, but the flames did not reach the spot where Tao had died; his corpse stood upright without falling, and bandits who saw it fled in terror.

sentences.zh: 已，覓州印，得之燾所立尺士下。

translations.literal: Later, searching for the prefectural seal, they found it one chi of earth beneath where Tao had stood.
translations.idiomatic: Later, searching for the prefectural seal, they found it buried one chi beneath the earth where Tao had stood.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太常少卿。

translations.literal: When the affair was reported, he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 福王時，賜謚烈湣，建雙忠祠，與同邑蔡懋德並祀。

translations.literal: During the reign of the Prince of Fu, he was granted the posthumous title Lie Min, and a Twin Loyalty Shrine was built; he was worshipped together with Cai Maode of the same county.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of the Prince of Fu, he was granted the posthumous title Lie Min (Fierce and Compassionate); a Twin Loyalty Shrine was built, and he was worshipped together with Cai Maode of the same county.

sentences.zh: 有魏時光者，南昌人。

translations.literal: There was one Wei Shiguang, a native of Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Wei Shiguang, a native of Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 善舞雙刀。

translations.literal: He was skilled at wielding twin swords.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled at wielding twin swords.

sentences.zh: 崇禎九年夏，為廣濟典史。

translations.literal: In the summer of the ninth year of Chongzhen, he served as clerk of Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the ninth year of the Chongzhen reign, he served as clerk of Guangji.

sentences.zh: 邑遭殘破，長吏設排兵三百人，委之教練。

translations.literal: The county had been ravaged; the chief official set up three hundred militia and entrusted their training to him.
translations.idiomatic: The county had been ravaged; the chief official raised three hundred militia and entrusted their training to him.

sentences.zh: 其冬，賊據蘄州河口，憚時光不敢渡。

translations.literal: That winter, bandits occupied the Qizhou river mouth; they feared Shiguang and did not dare cross.
translations.idiomatic: That winter bandits occupied the Qizhou river mouth; they feared Shiguang and did not dare cross.

sentences.zh: 時光益募死士，夜襲其營，手殺數賊，賊不敢逼。

translations.literal: Shiguang further recruited men willing to die, raided their camp by night, personally killed several bandits; the bandits did not dare press close.
translations.idiomatic: Shiguang further recruited volunteers willing to die, raided their camp by night, and personally killed several bandits; the bandits did not dare press close.

sentences.zh: 俄賊大至，部卒皆散，時光單騎據高坡，又殺數人。

translations.literal: Soon a large bandit force arrived; his troops all scattered; Shiguang alone on horseback held a high slope and killed several more.
translations.idiomatic: Soon a large bandit force arrived and his troops all scattered; Shiguang alone on horseback held a high slope and killed several more.

sentences.zh: 賊環繞之，靷斷被執，不屈死。

translations.literal: Bandits surrounded him; his bridle reins broke and he was seized; he died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits surrounded him; his bridle reins snapped and he was seized, but he died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 其兄陳於上官，卻不奏。

translations.literal: His elder brother reported the matter to superiors, but no memorial was submitted.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother reported the matter to his superiors, but no memorial was submitted to the throne.

sentences.zh: 兄憤發病死，友人收殮之，哭盡哀，曰：「弟為國死，兄為弟死，吾獨不能表暴之乎！」

translations.literal: The elder brother died of rage and illness; friends collected his body for burial; he wept his full grief and said: My younger brother died for the state; I die for my brother — can I alone fail to proclaim this great deed!
translations.idiomatic: The elder brother died of rage and grief; friends gathered his body for burial. Before he died he wept his full grief and said, "My younger brother died for the state; I die for my brother — can I alone fail to proclaim this deed to the world!

sentences.zh: 具牘力陳，乃奏聞。

translations.literal: He prepared a detailed petition forcefully stating the case, and only then was it reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: He prepared a detailed petition forcefully setting out the case, and only then was it reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 贈廣濟主簿，予恤典。

translations.literal: Shiguang was posthumously made Recorder of Guangji, and mourning honors were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Shiguang was posthumously made Recorder of Guangji, and mourning honors were granted.

sentences.zh: 蔣佳徵，灌陽人。

translations.literal: Jiang Jiazheng was a native of Guanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Jiazheng was from Guanyang.

sentences.zh: 天啟四年舉於鄉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianqi he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Tianqi reign he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，知盱眙縣，有聲。

translations.literal: During Chongzhen he served as magistrate of Xuyi, with a good reputation.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign he served as magistrate of Xuyi and earned a fine reputation.

sentences.zh: 縣故無城，佳徵知賊必至，訓民為兵。

translations.literal: The county originally had no walls; Jiazheng knew bandits would surely come and trained the people as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The county originally had no walls; Jiazheng knew bandits would surely come and trained the people as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 十年秋，賊果來犯，設伏要害，親率兵往誘，賊殲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the tenth year bandits indeed came to attack; he set ambushes at strategic points, personally led troops to lure them, and a great many bandits were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the tenth year bandits indeed came to attack; he set ambushes at key points, personally led troops to lure them in, and a great many bandits were annihilated.

sentences.zh: 賊怒，環攻之，力戰死。

translations.literal: The bandits were enraged, surrounded and attacked him; he fought hard and died.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, the bandits surrounded and attacked him; he fought hard and died.

sentences.zh: 母聞之，亦投繯死。

translations.literal: His mother heard of it and also hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother heard of it, she too hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 兵部議贈奉訓大夫、尚寶少卿。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War recommended posthumously making him Grand Master for Proper Instruction and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Seals.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War recommended posthumously making him Grand Master for Proper Instruction and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Seals.

sentences.zh: 未幾，巡按御史言佳徵子忠母義，宜賜謚蔭，以植倫常。

translations.literal: Before long, the touring censor said Jiazheng's filial son and righteous mother deserved posthumous titles and hereditary honors, to establish human relations and moral constants.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the touring censor said that Jiazheng's filial devotion and his mother's righteousness deserved posthumous titles and hereditary honors, to uphold the moral order.

sentences.zh: 乃建表忠祠，並母奉祀。

translations.literal: A Shrine to Manifest Loyalty was then built, and his mother was worshipped together with him.
translations.idiomatic: A Shrine to Manifest Loyalty was then built, and his mother was worshipped together with him.

sentences.zh: 同時江北死難者，有吳暢春。

translations.literal: Among those who died in the crisis in Jiangbei at the same time was Wu Changchun.
translations.idiomatic: Among those who died in the crisis in Jiangbei at the same time was Wu Changchun.

sentences.zh: 崇禎八年為潛山天堂寨巡檢，練鄉兵防賊。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Chongzhen he served as inspector of Tiantangzhai in Qianshan, training local militia to guard against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of the Chongzhen reign he served as inspector of Tiantangzhai in Qianshan, training local militia to guard against bandits.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，賊至，夜設燎，大驚去之。

translations.literal: The next winter bandits came; he set signal fires by night and greatly frightened them into leaving.
translations.idiomatic: The next winter bandits came; he set signal fires by night and greatly frightened them into retreat.

sentences.zh: 逾年，賊再至，暢春死守，力屈，仰天嘆曰：「吾得死所矣！」

translations.literal: After a year bandits came again; Changchun defended to the death; his strength exhausted, he looked up to heaven and sighed: I have found the place where I shall die!
translations.idiomatic: A year later the bandits came again; Changchun defended to the death until his strength was spent, then looked up to heaven and sighed, "I have found the place where I shall die!

sentences.zh: 手刃數賊，被執不屈死。

translations.literal: He personally blade-killed several bandits, was seized, and died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: He personally killed several bandits with his blade, was seized, and died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 贈迪功郎、安慶府經歷，蔭子所鎮撫。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Progression Officer and administrative assistant of Anqing Prefecture; his son was granted the post of garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Progression Officer and administrative assistant of Anqing Prefecture, and his son was granted the post of garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 又有王寅，錢塘人。

translations.literal: There was also Wang Yin, a native of Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Wang Yin, a native of Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 膂力絕人，舉武鄉試，以父征播功為千戶。

translations.literal: His physical strength was unmatched; he passed the military provincial examination; for his father's meritorious service in the Bozhou campaign he was made a company commander.
translations.idiomatic: His physical strength was unmatched; he passed the military provincial examination and, for his father's meritorious service in the Bozhou campaign, was made a company commander.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，擢撫標守備。

translations.literal: During Chongzhen he was promoted to garrison commander of the Jiangsu garrison.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign he was promoted to garrison commander of the Jiangsu garrison.

sentences.zh: 見步卒脆弱，詫曰：「曩戚將軍練浙兵，聞天下，今若爾邪！」

translations.literal: Seeing the infantry weak, he exclaimed in astonishment: In the past General Qi trained Zhejiang troops renowned throughout the realm — and now they are like this!
translations.idiomatic: Seeing how weak the infantry were, he exclaimed in astonishment, "In the past General Qi trained Zhejiang troops famed throughout the realm — and now they are like this!

sentences.zh: 督教之，卒始可用。

translations.literal: He supervised their training; only then did the troops become usable.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised their training, and only then did the troops become fit for battle.

sentences.zh: 十年遷龍江都司，調赴泗州護祖陵。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Longjiang commandant, dispatched to Sizhou to guard the imperial ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to Longjiang commandant and dispatched to Sizhou to guard the imperial ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 賊來犯，寅曰：「賊眾我寡，及其未集，可破也。」

translations.literal: When bandits came to attack, Yin said: The bandits are many and we are few; before they assemble, we can break them.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits came to attack, Yin said, "The bandits are many and we are few; before they assemble, we can break them.

sentences.zh: 卷甲疾趨，至盱眙，斬其先鋒一人。

translations.literal: He rolled up his armor and hurried; reaching Xuyi, he beheaded one of their vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: He rolled up his armor and hurried forward; reaching Xuyi, he beheaded one of their vanguard.

sentences.zh: 戰自午迄申，賊來益眾，與守備陳正亨陷陣死。

translations.literal: Battle lasted from noon until the shen hour; bandits came in ever greater numbers; he and Garrison Commander Chen Zhengheng fell in battle and died.
translations.idiomatic: The battle lasted from noon until the shen hour; bandits came in ever greater numbers, and he and Garrison Commander Chen Zhengheng fell in battle and died.

sentences.zh: 贈鎮國將軍、都指揮僉事。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made General Who Pacifies the State and Assistant Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made General Who Pacifies the State and Assistant Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正亨贈昭勇將軍、指揮使。

translations.literal: Zhengheng was posthumously made General of Manifest Valor and Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengheng was posthumously made General of Manifest Valor and Commandant.

sentences.zh: 並官一子。

translations.literal: One son of each was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: One son of each was granted an official post.

sentences.zh: 徐尚卿，南平人。

translations.literal: Xu Shangqing was a native of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shangqing was from Nanping.

sentences.zh: 舉於鄉，知劍州。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination and served as prefect of Jianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination and served as prefect of Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十年十月，李自成、惠登相等以數十萬眾入四川，大將侯良柱敗歿於廣元，遂攻陷昭化，知縣王時化死之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the tenth year of Chongzhen, Li Zicheng, Hui Dengxiang and others entered Sichuan with a force of several hundred thousand; Grand General Hou Liangzhu was defeated and killed at Guangyuan; they then captured Zhaohua, and Magistrate Wang Shihua died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the tenth year of the Chongzhen reign, Li Zicheng, Hui Dengxiang, and others entered Sichuan with a force of several hundred thousand; Grand General Hou Liangzhu was defeated and killed at Guangyuan; they then captured Zhaohua, and Magistrate Wang Shihua died in its defense.

sentences.zh: 尚卿知賊必至，集士民泣曰：「城必不能守，若輩速去，吾死此。」

translations.literal: Shangqing knew bandits would surely come; he gathered officials and people and wept: The city surely cannot be held; you all should leave quickly; I shall die here.
translations.idiomatic: Shangqing knew the bandits would surely come; he gathered officials and townspeople and wept, "The city cannot be held; you must leave at once — I shall die here.

sentences.zh: 眾泣，請偕去，尚卿不可。

translations.literal: The crowd wept and asked to leave together; Shangqing would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd wept and begged to leave together, but Shangqing would not agree.

sentences.zh: 閱二日，城陷，投繯死，吏目李英俊從之。

translations.literal: After two days the city fell; he hanged himself; Clerk Li Yingjun followed him in death.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later the city fell; he hanged himself, and Clerk Li Yingjun followed him in death.

sentences.zh: 賊遂長驅陷江油、彰明、安縣、羅江、德陽、漢州，吏民皆先遁。

translations.literal: The bandits then drove straight forward and captured Jiangyou, Zhangming, An County, Luojiang, Deyang, and Hanzhou; officials and people had all fled beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits then drove straight forward and captured Jiangyou, Zhangming, An County, Luojiang, Deyang, and Hanzhou; officials and people had all fled beforehand.

sentences.zh: 尋掠郫縣，主簿張應奇死之。

translations.literal: Soon they plundered Pixian; Recorder Zhang Yingqi died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they plundered Pixian, and Recorder Zhang Yingqi died in its defense.

sentences.zh: 陷金堂，典史潘孟科死之。

translations.literal: They captured Jintang; Clerk Pan Mengke died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: They captured Jintang, and Clerk Pan Mengke died in its defense.

sentences.zh: 是月也，賊陷州縣三十六，以死事聞者四人。

translations.literal: In that month bandits captured thirty-six prefectures and counties; four who died in service were reported.
translations.idiomatic: That month the bandits captured thirty-six prefectures and counties; only four who died in service were reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 事定，贈尚卿右參議，時化光祿丞，應奇按察司知事，孟科將仕郎，並賜恤典。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, Shangqing was posthumously made Right Assistant Censor, Shihua Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Yingqi Secretariat Associate of the Provincial Surveillance Commission, Mengke Officer for Merit; all were granted mourning honors.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs were settled, Shangqing was posthumously made Right Assistant Censor, Shihua Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Yingqi Secretariat Associate of the Provincial Surveillance Commission, and Mengke Officer for Merit; all were granted mourning honors.

sentences.zh: 時化，湖廣人，舉鄉試第一。

translations.literal: Shihua was a native of Huguang; he ranked first in the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: Shihua was a native of Huguang and had ranked first in the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 阮之鈿，字實甫，桐城諸生。

translations.literal: Ruan Zhitian, courtesy name Shifu, was a licentiate of Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Zhitian, whose courtesy name was Shifu, was a licentiate of Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，下詔保舉人才，同郡諭德劉若宰以之鈿應，授谷城知縣。

translations.literal: During Chongzhen an edict was issued recommending talent; Lecturer Liu Ruozai of the same prefecture recommended Zhitian; he was appointed magistrate of Gucheng.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign an edict was issued recommending talent; Lecturer Liu Ruozai of the same prefecture recommended Zhitian, and he was appointed magistrate of Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，之鈿未至，張獻忠襲陷其城，據以求撫。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year, before Zhitian had arrived, Zhang Xianzhong suddenly captured the city and occupied it seeking pacification.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year, before Zhitian had arrived, Zhang Xianzhong suddenly captured the city and occupied it seeking pacification.

sentences.zh: 總理熊文燦許之，處其眾數萬於四郊，居民洶洶欲竄。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Xiong Wencan agreed; he settled their force of tens of thousands in the outskirts; residents were in uproar wishing to flee.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Xiong Wencan agreed and settled their force of tens of thousands in the outskirts; the residents were in uproar and wished to flee.

sentences.zh: 之鈿至，盡心調劑，民稍安，乃上疏言：「獻忠虎踞邑城，其謀叵測。

translations.literal: When Zhitian arrived, he devoted himself to conciliation; the people were somewhat calmed; he then memorialized saying: Xianzhong crouches like a tiger in the county seat; his designs are inscrutable.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhitian arrived, he devoted himself to conciliation until the people were somewhat calmed, then memorialized, "Xianzhong crouches like a tiger in the county seat, and his designs are inscrutable.

sentences.zh: 所要求之地，實兵餉取道咽喉，秦、蜀交會脈絡，今皆為所據。

translations.literal: The territory he demands is in truth the throat through which military funds pass, the lifeline where Qin and Shu meet — all are now in his possession.
translations.idiomatic: The territory he demands is in truth the throat through which military funds pass, the lifeline where Qin and Shu meet — all are now in his possession.

sentences.zh: 奸民甘心效用，善良悉為迫脅。

translations.literal: Wicked people gladly serve him; the good are all coerced.
translations.idiomatic: Wicked people gladly serve him, while the good are all coerced.

sentences.zh: 臣守土牧民之官，至無土可守，無民可牧。

translations.literal: I am an official charged to guard the land and shepherd the people — yet I have no land to guard and no people to shepherd.
translations.idiomatic: I am an official charged to guard the land and shepherd the people — yet I have no land to guard and no people to shepherd.

sentences.zh: 庫藏殫虛，民產被奪，無賦可征。

translations.literal: The treasury is utterly empty, people's property has been seized — there are no taxes to levy.
translations.idiomatic: The treasury is utterly empty, the people's property has been seized, and there are no taxes to levy.

sentences.zh: 名雖縣令，實贅員爾。

translations.literal: In name I am county magistrate; in truth I am merely a supernumerary.
translations.idiomatic: In name I am county magistrate; in truth I am merely a supernumerary.

sentences.zh: 乃廟堂之上專主撫議，臣愚妄謂撫剿二策可合言，未可分言，致損國威，而挫士氣。」

translations.literal: Yet at court they insist solely on pacification; this humble official ventures to say that the two policies of pacification and suppression may be discussed together, not separately — resulting in damage to national prestige and dampening of troop morale.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at court they insist solely on pacification; this humble official ventures to say that the two policies of pacification and suppression may be discussed together, not separately — to the damage of national prestige and the dampening of troop morale.

sentences.zh: 時不能用。

translations.literal: At the time they would not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time his advice was not heeded.

sentences.zh: 賊眾漸出野外行劫，之鈿執之以告其營將，稍置之法。

translations.literal: The bandit followers gradually went out into the countryside to raid; Zhitian seized them and reported them to their camp commanders, who occasionally punished them according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit followers gradually began raiding in the countryside; Zhitian seized them and reported them to their camp commanders, who occasionally punished them according to law.

sentences.zh: 及再告，皆不應，曰：「官司不給餉耳，得餉自止。」

translations.literal: When he reported again, none responded, saying: The authorities simply do not issue rations; once rations are received they will stop on their own.
translations.idiomatic: When he reported again, none responded, saying, "The authorities simply do not issue rations; once we receive rations we will stop on our own.

sentences.zh: 由是村民徙亡殆盡，遂掠及阛阓。

translations.literal: Hence the villagers fled until nearly all were gone, and plunder soon reached the market streets.
translations.idiomatic: Consequently the villagers fled until nearly all were gone, and plunder soon reached the market streets.

sentences.zh: 稍拒，輒挺刃相向，日有死者，一城大囂。

translations.literal: If anyone resisted even slightly, they would draw blades and confront one another; there were deaths daily, and the whole city was in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: If anyone resisted even slightly, they would draw blades and confront one another; deaths occurred daily, and the whole city was in uproar.

sentences.zh: 監軍僉事張大經奉文燦令來鎮撫，亦不能禁。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zhang Dajing, on Wencan's orders, came to pacify the situation, yet he too could not restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Zhang Dajing came on Wencan's orders to pacify the situation, yet he too could not restrain them.

sentences.zh: 明年，獻忠反形漸露，之鈿往說之曰：「將軍始所為甚悖，今幸得為王臣，當從軍立功，垂名竹帛。

translations.literal: The next year, as Xianzhong's rebellious intent gradually showed, Zhitian went to persuade him, saying: General, what you did at first was very perverse; now you are fortunate to have become a subject of the throne — you ought to follow the army and achieve merit, leaving your name on bamboo and silk.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, as Xianzhong's rebellious intent gradually showed, Zhitian went to persuade him: "General, what you did at first was very perverse; now you are fortunate to have become a subject of the throne — you ought to follow the army and achieve merit and leave your name recorded in history.

sentences.zh: 且不見劉將軍國能乎？

translations.literal: Have you not seen General Liu Guoneng?
translations.idiomatic: Have you not seen what happened to General Liu Guoneng?

sentences.zh: 天子手詔進宮，厚賫金帛，此赤誠效也。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven personally issued an edict summoning him to court and lavishly bestowed gold and silks — this was the reward of sincere loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally issued an edict summoning him to court and lavishly bestowed gold and silks — that was the reward of sincere loyalty.

sentences.zh: 將軍若疑天朝有異論，之鈿請以百口保。

translations.literal: If the General doubts that the dynasty holds other views, Zhitian asks to guarantee this with the lives of a hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: If you doubt that the dynasty holds other views, Zhitian asks to guarantee this with the lives of a hundred people.

sentences.zh: 何嫌何疑，而復懷他誌。」

translations.literal: What grievance, what doubt — that you should again harbor other designs?
translations.idiomatic: What grievance or doubt could you have that you should again harbor other designs?

sentences.zh: 獻忠素銜之鈿，遂惡言極罵之。

translations.literal: Xianzhong had long harbored a grudge against Zhitian; he then hurled foul abuse at him.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhong had long harbored a grudge against Zhitian and now hurled foul abuse at him.

sentences.zh: 之鈿憂憤成病，題數語於壁，自誓以死，遂不視事。

translations.literal: Zhitian, worn by grief and anger, fell ill; he wrote several lines on the wall, vowing to die, and then ceased to attend to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhitian, worn by grief and anger, fell ill; he wrote several lines on the wall vowing to die, and then ceased to attend to affairs.

sentences.zh: 至五月，獻忠果反，劫庫縱囚，毀其城。

translations.literal: By the fifth month Xianzhong did indeed rebel, plundered the treasury, released prisoners, and destroyed the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth month Xianzhong did indeed rebel, plundered the treasury, released prisoners, and destroyed the city walls.

sentences.zh: 之鈿仰藥未絕，獻忠遣使索印，堅不予，賊遂殺之。

translations.literal: Zhitian had taken poison but was not yet dead; Xianzhong sent messengers to demand his seal; he steadfastly refused to give it, and the bandits then killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhitian had taken poison but was not yet dead; Xianzhong sent messengers to demand his seal; he steadfastly refused, and the bandits then killed him.

sentences.zh: 旋縱火焚公署，骸骨為燼。

translations.literal: They soon set fire and burned the official residence; his bones were reduced to ashes.
translations.idiomatic: They soon set fire to the official residence, and his bones were reduced to ashes.

sentences.zh: 而大經為賊劫去，不能死。

translations.literal: As for Dajing, he was carried off by the bandits and could not die.
translations.idiomatic: Dajing, however, was carried off by the bandits and failed to die.

sentences.zh: 迨瑪瑙山戰敗，偕賊將曹威等出降，士論醜之。

translations.literal: When they were defeated at Mount Agate, he surrendered together with the bandit generals Cao Wei and others; public opinion reviled him.
translations.idiomatic: When they were defeated at Mount Agate, he surrendered together with the bandit generals Cao Wei and others, and public opinion reviled him.

sentences.zh: 之鈿後贈尚寶少卿。

translations.literal: Zhitian was later posthumously made Vice Minister of the Imperial Insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Zhitian was later posthumously made Vice Minister of the Imperial Insignia.

sentences.zh: 郝景春，字和滿，江都人。

translations.literal: Hao Jingchun, courtesy name Heman, was a native of Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Jingchun, whose courtesy name was Heman, was a native of Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 舉於鄉，署鹽城教諭，坐事罷歸。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination, was appointed instructor at Yancheng, and was dismissed and sent home because of an affair.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination, served as instructor at Yancheng, and was dismissed and sent home after an incident.

sentences.zh: 起陜西苑馬寺萬安監錄事，量移黃州照磨，攝黃安縣事。

translations.literal: He was recalled as clerk of the Wan'an Stud of the Shaanxi Pasturage Commission, was transferred by seniority to recorder at Huangzhou, and acted as administrator of Huang'an County.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as clerk of the Wan'an Stud of the Shaanxi Pasturage Commission, was transferred by seniority to recorder at Huangzhou, and acted as administrator of Huang'an County.

sentences.zh: 甫三日，群賊奄至，堅守八日夜，始解去。

translations.literal: On the third day a band of bandits suddenly arrived; he held firm for eight days and nights before they finally withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day a band of bandits suddenly arrived; he held firm for eight days and nights before they finally withdrew.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十一年，擢知房縣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chongzhen he was promoted and appointed magistrate of Fang County.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chongzhen he was promoted and appointed magistrate of Fang County.

sentences.zh: 羅汝才率九營之眾請降於熊文燦，文燦受之。

translations.literal: Luo Rucai led the forces of nine camps to seek surrender from Xiong Wencan, and Wencan accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Rucai led the forces of nine camps to seek surrender from Xiong Wencan, and Wencan accepted them.

sentences.zh: 汝才猶豫，景春單騎入其營，偕汝才及其黨白貴、黑雲祥歃血盟。

translations.literal: Rucai hesitated; Jingchun rode alone into his camp and, together with Rucai and his followers Bai Gui and Hei Yunxiang, swore a blood oath.
translations.idiomatic: Rucai hesitated; Jingchun rode alone into his camp and, together with Rucai and his followers Bai Gui and Hei Yunxiang, swore a blood oath.

sentences.zh: 汝才詣軍門降，分諸營於竹谿、保康、上津，而自與貴、雲祥居房縣之野。

translations.literal: Rucai went to the army headquarters to surrender; the various camps were distributed to Zhuxi, Baokang, and Shangjin, while he himself, together with Gui and Yunxiang, lived in the wilds of Fang County.
translations.idiomatic: Rucai went to army headquarters to surrender; the various camps were distributed to Zhuxi, Baokang, and Shangjin, while he himself, together with Gui and Yunxiang, encamped in the wilds of Fang County.

sentences.zh: 當是時，鄖陽諸屬邑，城郭為墟，獨房賴景春拊循，粗可守。

translations.literal: At that time among the subordinate counties of Yunyang, city walls had become ruins; only Fang, relying on Jingchun's consoling rule, was roughly defensible.
translations.idiomatic: At that time among the subordinate counties of Yunyang, city walls lay in ruins; only Fang, relying on Jingchun's consoling rule, was roughly defensible.

sentences.zh: 及大眾雜處，居民日惴惴。

translations.literal: When the large forces lived mixed together, the residents grew daily more fearful.
translations.idiomatic: When the large forces were quartered together among them, the residents grew daily more fearful.

sentences.zh: 景春乃與主簿朱邦聞、守備楊道選修守具，輯諸營。

translations.literal: Jingchun then, together with Registrar Zhu Bangwen and Guard Commander Yang Daoxuan, prepared defenses and organized the various camps.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchun then, together with Registrar Zhu Bangwen and Guard Commander Yang Daoxuan, prepared defenses and organized the various camps.

sentences.zh: 明年五月，張獻忠反谷城，約汝才同反。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year Zhang Xianzhong rebelled at Gucheng and invited Rucai to rebel with him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the following year Zhang Xianzhong rebelled at Gucheng and invited Rucai to rebel with him.

sentences.zh: 景春子鳴鑾，諸生也，力敵萬夫，謂父曰：「吾城當賊沖，而羸卒止二百，城何以守？」

translations.literal: Jingchun's son Mingluan, a licentiate, had strength to match ten thousand men; he said to his father: Our city lies in the bandits' path, yet our weak soldiers number only two hundred — how can the city be defended?
translations.idiomatic: Jingchun's son Mingluan, a licentiate with strength to match ten thousand men, said to his father, "Our city lies in the bandits' path, yet our weak soldiers number only two hundred — how can the city be defended?

sentences.zh: 乃擐甲詣汝才曰：「若不念香火盟乎？

translations.literal: He then donned armor and went to Rucai, saying: Do you not remember our blood-oath bond?
translations.idiomatic: He then donned armor and went to Rucai, saying, "Do you not remember our blood-oath bond?

sentences.zh: 慎毋從亂。」

translations.literal: Take care not to join the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Take care not to join the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 汝才佯諾。

translations.literal: Rucai pretended to agree.
translations.idiomatic: Rucai pretended to agree.

sentences.zh: 鳴鑾覺其偽，歸與道選授兵登陴，而獻忠所遣前鋒已至，擊斬其將上天龍。

translations.literal: Mingluan perceived the deceit; he returned and, with Daoxuan, armed the men and sent them up onto the battlements; Xianzhong's advance guard had already arrived, and they struck down and killed its general Shang Tianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Mingluan perceived the deceit; he returned and, with Daoxuan, armed the men and sent them onto the battlements; Xianzhong's advance guard had already arrived, and they struck down and killed its general Shang Tianlong.

sentences.zh: 遣使縋城乞援於文燦，凡十四往，不報。

translations.literal: They sent messengers who lowered themselves from the wall to beg aid from Wencan; in all they went fourteen times, but received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: They sent messengers who lowered themselves from the wall to beg aid from Wencan; they went fourteen times in all, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 已而賊大至，獻忠兵張白幟，汝才兵張赤幟，俄二幟相雜，環城力攻。

translations.literal: Before long the bandits arrived in force; Xianzhong's troops raised white banners, Rucai's troops raised red banners; soon the two banners were mixed together as they encircled the city and attacked with all their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the bandits arrived in force; Xianzhong's troops raised white banners and Rucai's red banners; soon the two were mixed together as they encircled the city and attacked with all their strength.

sentences.zh: 貴、雲祥策馬呼曰：「以城讓我，保無他也。」

translations.literal: Gui and Yunxiang spurred their horses and shouted: Give us the city and we guarantee no harm.
translations.idiomatic: Gui and Yunxiang spurred their horses and shouted, "Give us the city and we guarantee no harm.

sentences.zh: 獻忠又以張大經檄諭降，景春大罵碎之。

translations.literal: Xianzhong again used a proclamation from Zhang Dajing to urge surrender; Jingchun cursed it bitterly and tore it to pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhong again used a proclamation from Zhang Dajing to urge surrender; Jingchun cursed it bitterly and tore it to pieces.

sentences.zh: 鳴鸞且守且戰，閱五日，賊多死。

translations.literal: Mingluan both defended and fought; after five days many bandits were dead.
translations.idiomatic: Mingluan both defended and fought; after five days many bandits were dead.

sentences.zh: 乃負板穴城，城將崩，鳴鑾熱油灌之。

translations.literal: The bandits then carried planks to tunnel under the wall; as the wall was about to collapse, Mingluan poured boiling oil over them.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits then carried planks to tunnel under the wall; as the wall was about to collapse, Mingluan poured boiling oil over them.

sentences.zh: 又擊傷獻忠左足，殺其所愛善馬。

translations.literal: He also wounded Xianzhong's left foot and killed his favorite fine horse.
translations.idiomatic: He also wounded Xianzhong's left foot and killed his favorite fine horse.

sentences.zh: 乃用間入賊壘，陰識獻忠所臥帳，將襲擒之。

translations.literal: They then sent a spy into the bandit camp who secretly identified the tent where Xianzhong slept, intending to make a surprise capture.
translations.idiomatic: They then sent a spy into the bandit camp who secretly identified the tent where Xianzhong slept, intending to make a surprise capture.

sentences.zh: 指揮張三錫啟北門揖汝才入，道選巷戰死。

translations.literal: Commander Zhang Sanxi opened the north gate and ushered Rucai in; Daoxuan died fighting in the lanes.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Zhang Sanxi opened the north gate and ushered Rucai in; Daoxuan died fighting in the lanes.

sentences.zh: 大經使汝才說景春降，怒不答。

translations.literal: Dajing had Rucai persuade Jingchun to surrender; enraged, he made no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Dajing had Rucai persuade Jingchun to surrender; enraged, he made no reply.

sentences.zh: 問庫藏儲蓄安在，叱曰：「庫藏若有物，城豈為汝陷！」

translations.literal: They asked where the treasury stores were kept; he shouted: If the treasury held anything, how could the city have fallen to you!
translations.idiomatic: They asked where the treasury stores were kept; he shouted, "If the treasury held anything, how could the city have fallen to you!

sentences.zh: 賊怒，殺一典史、一守備恐之，卒不屈，與鳴鑾俱被殺。

translations.literal: The bandits were enraged; they killed one county clerk and one guard commander to intimidate him; he still would not yield, and he and Mingluan were both killed.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were enraged; they killed one county clerk and one guard commander to intimidate him; he still would not yield, and he and Mingluan were both killed.

sentences.zh: 仆陳宜赤死之。

translations.literal: Servant Chen Yichi died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Servant Chen Yichi died with him.

sentences.zh: 邦聞及其家人並不屈死。

translations.literal: Bangwen and his family all refused to yield and died.
translations.idiomatic: Bangwen and his family all refused to yield and died.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈景春尚寶少卿，建祠奉祀，道選等亦贈恤。

translations.literal: When the affair was reported, Jingchun was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Imperial Insignia and a shrine was built for his veneration; Daoxuan and others were also posthumously honored with mourning grants.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was reported, Jingchun was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Imperial Insignia and a shrine was built for his veneration; Daoxuan and others were also posthumously honored with mourning grants.

sentences.zh: 已，帝召見輔臣賀逢聖，備述其死事狀，改贈太仆少卿。

translations.literal: Later the emperor summoned Grand Secretary He Fengsheng and had him fully recount the circumstances of his death in service; the posthumous rank was changed to Vice Minister of the Directorate of Horses.
translations.idiomatic: Later the emperor summoned Grand Secretary He Fengsheng and had him fully recount the circumstances of his death in service; the posthumous rank was changed to Vice Minister of the Directorate of Horses.

sentences.zh: 三錫後為官軍所獲，磔死。

translations.literal: Sanxi was later captured by government troops and executed by dismemberment.
translations.idiomatic: Sanxi was later captured by government troops and executed by dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 張克儉，字禹型，屯留人。

translations.literal: Zhang Kejian, courtesy name Yuxing, was a native of Tunliu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Kejian, whose courtesy name was Yuxing, was a native of Tunliu.

sentences.zh: 崇禎四年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the fourth year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He was a jinshi of the fourth year of Chongzhen.

sentences.zh: 授輝縣知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Huixian.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Huixian.

sentences.zh: 六年春，賊犯武安，守備曹鳴鶚戰死，遂犯輝縣。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year bandits attacked Wu'an; Guard Commander Cao Ming'e died in battle, and they then attacked Huixian.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year bandits attacked Wu'an; Guard Commander Cao Ming'e died in battle, and they then attacked Huixian.

sentences.zh: 克儉乘城固守，賊不能下，屯百泉書院，三日而去。

translations.literal: Kejian mounted the walls and held firm; the bandits could not take it; they encamped at Baiquan Academy and left after three days.
translations.idiomatic: Kejian mounted the walls and held firm; the bandits could not take the city; they encamped at Baiquan Academy and left after three days.

sentences.zh: 遷兵部主事，被薦召對，稱旨。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be a secretary in the Ministry of War; recommended and summoned for audience, he pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to be a secretary in the Ministry of War; recommended and summoned for audience, he pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 十二年擢湖廣僉事，監鄖、襄諸軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Vice Commissioner of Huguang and supervised the armies of Yun and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Vice Commissioner of Huguang and supervised the armies of Yun and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 楊嗣昌鎮襄陽，深倚仗之。

translations.literal: When Yang Sichang was stationed at Xiangyang, he relied deeply on him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Sichang was stationed at Xiangyang, he relied deeply on him.

sentences.zh: 張獻忠、羅汝才之敗也，小秦王、渾世王、過天星等皆降，嗣昌處之房、竹山中，命克儉安輯。

translations.literal: When Zhang Xianzhong and Luo Rucai were defeated, Little King of Qin, King of Universal World, Guo Tianxing, and others all surrendered; Sichang settled them in the mountains of Fang and Zhushan and ordered Kejian to pacify and organize them.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Xianzhong and Luo Rucai were defeated, Little King of Qin, King of Universal World, Guo Tianxing, and others all surrendered; Sichang settled them in the mountains of Fang and Zhushan and ordered Kejian to pacify and organize them.

sentences.zh: 而諸賊得免死牌，莫肯散，自擇便地，連營數百里。

translations.literal: But the bandits, having received death-exemption plaques, were unwilling to disperse; they chose convenient places for themselves and encamped in linked camps for hundreds of li.
translations.idiomatic: But the bandits, having received death-exemption plaques, were unwilling to disperse; they chose convenient places for themselves and encamped in linked camps stretching for hundreds of li.

sentences.zh: 時河南、北大饑，流民就食襄、漢者日數萬，降卒多闌入流民中。

translations.literal: At the time Henan and the north suffered great famine; refugees seeking food in Xiang and Han numbered tens of thousands daily, and many surrendered soldiers mingled among the refugees.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Henan and the north suffered great famine; refugees seeking food in Xiang and Han numbered tens of thousands daily, and many surrendered soldiers mingled among the refugees.

sentences.zh: 克儉深憂之，上書嗣昌曰：「襄陽自古要區，本朝筦鑰獻陵，視昔尤重。

translations.literal: Kejian was deeply troubled and memorialized Sichang, saying: Xiangyang has from antiquity been a vital region; in our dynasty it is the key to the imperial tombs at Xianling, and is even more important than before.
translations.idiomatic: Kejian was deeply troubled and memorialized Sichang, saying, "Xiangyang has from antiquity been a vital region; in our dynasty it is the key to the imperial tombs at Xianling, and is even more important than before.

sentences.zh: 近兩河饑民雲集，新舊降丁逼處其間，一夫叫呼，即足致亂。

translations.literal: Recently famine refugees from the two Yellow River regions have gathered like clouds; new and old surrendered soldiers are pressed together among them — one man's shout would suffice to cause disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Recently famine refugees from the two Yellow River regions have gathered like clouds; new and old surrendered soldiers are pressed together among them — one man's shout would suffice to cause disorder.

sentences.zh: 況秦兵以長、武之變，西歸鄖、房。

translations.literal: Moreover, because of the mutinies at Chang and Wu, Qin troops are returning west to Yun and Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, because of the mutinies at Chang and Wu, Qin troops are returning west to Yun and Fang.

sentences.zh: 軍府粗立，降營棋置，奚啻放虎自衛。

translations.literal: The military headquarters is only roughly established; surrendered camps are scattered like chess pieces — this is no different from releasing tigers to guard oneself.
translations.idiomatic: The military headquarters is only roughly established; surrendered camps are scattered like chess pieces — this is no different from releasing tigers to guard oneself.

sentences.zh: 紫、漢、西、興，初無重門之備，何恃不恐。」

translations.literal: The passes at Zi, Han, Xi, and Xing at first had no heavy defenses at their gates — on what do you rely that you are not afraid?
translations.idiomatic: The passes at Zi, Han, Xi, and Xing at first had no heavy defenses — on what do you rely that you are not afraid?

sentences.zh: 嗣昌不以為意，報曰：「昔高仁厚六日降賊百萬，迄擒阡能，監軍何怯耶？」

translations.literal: Sichang paid it no heed and replied: In former times Gao Renhou in six days received the surrender of a million bandits and finally captured Qian Neng — why is the supervising officer so timid?
translations.idiomatic: Sichang paid it no heed and replied, "In former times Gao Renhou in six days received the surrender of a million bandits and finally captured Qian Neng — why is the supervising officer so timid?"

sentences.zh: 及嗣昌入蜀，委克儉以留務。

translations.literal: When Sichang entered Shu, he entrusted Kejian with remaining affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Sichang entered Shu, he entrusted Kejian with the remaining affairs.

sentences.zh: 錄破賊功，加右參議，監軍如故。

translations.literal: His merit in defeating bandits was recorded; he was promoted to Right Assistant Censor while supervising troops as before.
translations.idiomatic: His merit in defeating bandits was recorded; he was promoted to Right Assistant Censor while continuing to supervise troops as before.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以本官移守下川南道，鄖陽巡撫袁繼咸奏留之。

translations.literal: Before long, in his original rank he was transferred to defend the Lower Southern Chuan Circuit; Yunyang Grand Coordinator Yuan Jixian memorialized to retain him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, retaining his original rank, he was transferred to defend the Lower Southern Chuan Circuit; Yunyang Grand Coordinator Yuan Jixian memorialized to retain him.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月擢右僉都御史，巡撫河南。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourteenth year he was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and appointed Grand Coordinator of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourteenth year he was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and appointed Grand Coordinator of Henan.

sentences.zh: 未聞命，獻忠令人假督府軍符誑入襄陽城。

translations.literal: Before he had received the appointment, Xianzhong had someone forge the grand coordinator's military tally to deceive their way into Xiangyang city.
translations.idiomatic: Before he had received the appointment, Xianzhong had someone forge the grand coordinator's military tally to deceive their way into Xiangyang city.

sentences.zh: 克儉不能辨，夜分，賊從中起，焚襄王府。

translations.literal: Kejian could not discern the fraud; at midnight the bandits rose from within and burned the Palace of the Prince of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Kejian could not discern the fraud; at midnight the bandits rose from within and burned the Palace of the Prince of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 克儉倉皇奔救，為賊所執，大罵死。

translations.literal: Kejian rushed in haste to the rescue, was seized by the bandits, cursed them bitterly, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Kejian rushed to the rescue, was seized by the bandits, cursed them bitterly, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 推官鄺曰廣、攝縣事李大覺、遊擊黎民安死焉。

translations.literal: Push Official Kuang Yueguang, Acting County Administrator Li Dajue, and Mobile Battalion Commander Li Min'an also died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Push Official Kuang Yueguang, Acting County Administrator Li Dajue, and Mobile Battalion Commander Li Min'an also died in the affair.

sentences.zh: 曰廣，番禺人。

translations.literal: Yueguang was a native of Panyu.
translations.idiomatic: Yueguang was a native of Panyu.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the tenth year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He was a jinshi of the tenth year of Chongzhen.

sentences.zh: 居官有守。

translations.literal: In office he was principled.
translations.idiomatic: In office he was principled.

sentences.zh: 奉檄核軍儲於荊州，甫還任而難作，中刃死，妻子女俱遇害。

translations.literal: On orders he audited military stores at Jingzhou; he had just returned to his post when disaster broke out; he was slashed and died, and his wife, sons, and daughter were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: On orders he audited military stores at Jingzhou; he had just returned to his post when disaster broke out; he was slashed and died, and his wife, sons, and daughter were all killed.

sentences.zh: 大覺，字覺之，金谿人。

translations.literal: Dajue, courtesy name Juezhi, was a native of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dajue, whose courtesy name was Juezhi, was a native of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 由鄉舉知谷城，兼署襄陽縣。

translations.literal: Through the provincial recommendation he became magistrate of Gucheng and concurrently served as acting magistrate of Xiangyang County.
translations.idiomatic: Through the provincial recommendation he became magistrate of Gucheng and concurrently served as acting magistrate of Xiangyang County.

sentences.zh: 聞變，系印於肘，縊死堂上。

translations.literal: On hearing of the uprising, he tied the seal to his elbow and hanged himself in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing of the uprising, he tied the seal to his elbow and hanged himself in the hall.

sentences.zh: 民安，大覺同縣人。
