translations.literal: Min'an was a fellow townsman of Dajue.
translations.idiomatic: Min'an was a fellow townsman of Dajue.

sentences.zh: 城中火起，率所部千余人搏戰，矢盡被縛，抗罵死。

translations.literal: When fire broke out in the city, he led more than a thousand of his men in fierce combat; when their arrows were exhausted they were bound, but he resisted with curses and died.
translations.idiomatic: When fire broke out in the city, he led more than a thousand of his men in fierce combat; when their arrows were exhausted they were bound, but he resisted with curses and was killed.

sentences.zh: 獨知府夏邑王承曾遁免。

translations.literal: Only Prefect Wang Chengzeng of Xiayi escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Only Prefect Wang Chengzeng of Xiayi escaped.

sentences.zh: 初，獻忠敗於瑪瑙山，其妻敖氏、高氏被獲，他將搜山，又獲其軍師潘獨鰲，皆系襄陽獄。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Xianzhong was defeated at Mount Agate, his wives Lady Ao and Lady Gao were captured; another general searched the mountains and also captured his strategist Pan Du'ao; all were imprisoned in Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Xianzhong was defeated at Mount Agate, his wives Lady Ao and Lady Gao were captured; another general searched the mountains and also captured his strategist Pan Du'ao; all were imprisoned in Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 承曾年少輕佻，每夕托問賊中情形，與獻忠二妻笑語。

translations.literal: Chengzeng was young and frivolous; each evening, on pretext of inquiring about conditions among the bandits, he joked and laughed with Xianzhong's two wives.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzeng was young and frivolous; each evening, on pretext of inquiring about conditions among the bandits, he joked and laughed with Xianzhong's two wives.

sentences.zh: 獄吏又多納賊金，禁防盡弛，獨鰲等脫桎梏恣飲。

translations.literal: The prison officials also accepted much bandit gold; restrictions were utterly relaxed; Du'ao and the others cast off their fetters and drank at will.
translations.idiomatic: The prison officials also accepted much bandit gold; restrictions were utterly relaxed; Du'ao and the others cast off their fetters and drank at will.

sentences.zh: 嗣昌移牒戒之，承曾笑曰：「是豈能飛至耶？」

translations.literal: Sichang sent a dispatch warning him; Chengzeng laughed and said: Can he really fly here?
translations.idiomatic: Sichang sent a dispatch warning him; Chengzeng laughed and said, "Can he really fly here?

sentences.zh: 及是，獨鰲果從獄中起，承曾率眾奪門走。

translations.literal: At this moment Du'ao indeed rose from the prison; Chengzeng led his followers to seize the gate and flee.
translations.idiomatic: At this moment Du'ao indeed rose from the prison; Chengzeng led his followers to seize the gate and flee.

sentences.zh: 事聞，命逮治。

translations.literal: When the affair was reported, an order was issued for his arrest and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was reported, an order was issued for his arrest and punishment.

sentences.zh: 時河南亦大亂，久逮不至，未知所終。

translations.literal: At the time Henan was also in great disorder; he was long sought but did not arrive; his ultimate fate is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Henan was also in great disorder; he was long sought but never apprehended, and his ultimate fate is unknown.

sentences.zh: 徐世淳，字中明，秀水人。

translations.literal: Xu Shichun, courtesy name Zhongming, was a native of Xiushui.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shichun, whose courtesy name was Zhongming, was a native of Xiushui.

sentences.zh: 父必達，字德夫，萬歷二十年進士。

translations.literal: His father Bida, courtesy name Defu, was a jinshi of the twentieth year of Wanli.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bida, whose courtesy name was Defu, was a jinshi of the twentieth year of Wanli.

sentences.zh: 知溧水縣，築石臼湖堤，奏除齊泰姻戚子孫軍籍二十六家。

translations.literal: As magistrate of Lishui County he built the Shijiu Lake embankment and memorialized to remove twenty-six families of Qi Tai's affinal kin from military registration.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Lishui County he built the Shijiu Lake embankment and memorialized to remove twenty-six families of Qi Tai's affinal kin from military registration.

sentences.zh: 累遷吏部考功郎中，與吏科給事中儲純臣同領察事。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Director in the Ministry of Personnel's Department of Evaluation, and together with Supervising Secretary Chu Chunchen of the Ministry of Personnel section jointly led the inspection affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Director in the Ministry of Personnel's Department of Evaluation and, together with Supervising Secretary Chu Chunchen of the Ministry of Personnel section, jointly led the inspection affairs.

sentences.zh: 純臣受贓吏賕，當大計日，必達進狀請黜純臣，面揖之退，一座大驚。

translations.literal: Chunchen had accepted bribes from a corrupt official; on the day of the grand assessment Bida submitted a memorial requesting Chunchen's dismissal, bowed to him face to face and withdrew — the whole assembly was greatly astonished.
translations.idiomatic: Chunchen had accepted bribes from a corrupt official; on the day of the grand assessment Bida submitted a memorial requesting Chunchen's dismissal, bowed to him face to face and withdrew, and the whole assembly was greatly astonished.

sentences.zh: 遷光祿丞，陳白糧利弊十一事，悉允行。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, presented eleven points on the advantages and disadvantages of white-grain transport, and all were approved and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, presented eleven points on the advantages and disadvantages of white-grain transport, and all were approved and carried out.

sentences.zh: 進少卿，巡漕御史孫居相以船壞不治，請雇民船濟運，必達爭止之。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director; Grain Transport Censor Sun Juxiang, because the boats were damaged and unrepaired, requested hiring civilian boats to aid transport, and Bida strenuously opposed and stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director; Grain Transport Censor Sun Juxiang, finding the boats damaged and unrepaired, requested hiring civilian boats to aid transport, but Bida strenuously opposed and stopped it.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，以右僉都御史督操江軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqi he was made Right Vice Censor-in-Chief to supervise the Caojiang army.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianqi he was made Right Vice Censor-in-Chief to supervise the Caojiang army.

sentences.zh: 白蓮賊將窺徐州，必達募銳卒會山東兵擊破之。

translations.literal: A White Lotus bandit general was watching Xuzhou; Bida recruited crack troops and together with Shandong forces defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: When a White Lotus bandit general threatened Xuzhou, Bida recruited crack troops and, together with Shandong forces, defeated him.

sentences.zh: 遷兵部右侍郎，以拾遺罷歸，卒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Right Vice Minister of War, was dismissed and sent home on a memorial of impeachment, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Right Vice Minister of War, was dismissed and sent home after a memorial of impeachment, and died.

sentences.zh: 世淳，崇禎中舉人。

translations.literal: Shichun was a juren during Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun was a juren during the Chongzhen reign.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，歷隨州知州。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year he served as prefect of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirteenth year he became prefect of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 州嘗被賊，居民蕭然。

translations.literal: The prefecture had been attacked by bandits, and the inhabitants were desolate.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had already been ravaged by bandits, and the inhabitants were desolate.

sentences.zh: 世淳知賊必復至，集士民誓以死守。

translations.literal: Shichun knew bandits would certainly return, gathered gentry and people, and swore to defend to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun knew the bandits would return, gathered gentry and people, and swore to defend the city to the death.

sentences.zh: 會歲大荒，士多就食粥廠，嘆曰：「可使士以餒失禮乎？」

translations.literal: It happened to be a year of great famine, and many scholars went to eat at soup kitchens; he sighed and said: Can we let scholars lose propriety through hunger?
translations.idiomatic: It happened to be a year of great famine, and many scholars went to eat at soup kitchens; he sighed and said, "Can we let scholars lose their dignity to hunger?

sentences.zh: 分粟振之。

translations.literal: He distributed grain to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: He distributed grain to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 潰兵過隨索餉，世淳授兵登陴，而單騎入見軍帥曰：「軍食不供，有司罪也。

translations.literal: Routed troops passing through Suizhou demanded pay; Shichun armed the men and sent them up on the walls, then rode alone in to see the army commander and said: If army provisions are not supplied, that is the fault of the officials.
translations.idiomatic: Routed troops passing through Suizhou demanded pay; Shichun armed the men and sent them onto the walls, then rode alone to see the army commander and said, "If army provisions are not supplied, that is the fault of the officials.

sentences.zh: 殺我足矣，請械我以見督師。」

translations.literal: Killing me is enough; please bind me and take me to see the supervising general.
translations.idiomatic: Killing me is enough; please bind me and take me to see the supervising general.

sentences.zh: 帥氣奪，斂眾去。

translations.literal: The commander's spirit was taken aback, and he gathered his men and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The commander's spirit was taken aback, and he gathered his men and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，張獻忠自襄陽來犯，世淳寢食南城譙樓，曉夜固守，告急於巡撫宋一鶴。

translations.literal: The following year in the third month Zhang Xianzhong came to attack from Xiangyang; Shichun ate and slept in the South Gate watchtower, held firm day and night, and sent urgent word to Grand Coordinator Song Yihe.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the third month, Zhang Xianzhong attacked from Xiangyang; Shichun ate and slept in the South Gate watchtower, held firm day and night, and sent urgent word to Grand Coordinator Song Yihe.

sentences.zh: 一鶴遣兵來援，為監司守承天者邀去。

translations.literal: Yihe sent troops to the rescue, but they were diverted by the supervisor defending Chengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Yihe sent troops to the rescue, but they were diverted by the supervisor defending Chengtian.

sentences.zh: 守月余，援絕力窮，賊急攻南城，而潛兵墮北城以入。

translations.literal: After defending for more than a month, relief was cut off and their strength exhausted; the bandits pressed the attack on the south wall while troops secretly scaled the north wall to enter.
translations.idiomatic: After defending for more than a month, relief was cut off and their strength exhausted; the bandits pressed the attack on the south wall while troops secretly scaled the north wall to enter.

sentences.zh: 世淳命子肇梁{艹}印廨後，勒馬巷戰，矢貫頤，耳鼻橫斷，墜馬，亂刃斫死。

translations.literal: Shichun ordered his son Zhaoliang to hide the seal behind the yamen, then spurred his horse to fight in the lanes; an arrow pierced his cheek, his nose and ears were severed crosswise, he fell from his horse, and was hacked to death by many blades.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun ordered his son Zhaoliang to hide the seal behind the yamen, then spurred his horse to fight in the lanes; an arrow pierced his cheek, his nose and ears were severed, he fell from his horse, and was hacked to death.

sentences.zh: 肇梁奔赴，且哭且罵，賊將殺之，呼州人告以{艹}印處，乃死。

translations.literal: Zhaoliang rushed forward, weeping and cursing; the bandits were about to kill him, but he called to the people of the prefecture to tell them where the seal was hidden, and then died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoliang rushed forward, weeping and cursing; the bandits were about to kill him, but he called to the people of the prefecture to tell them where the seal was hidden, and then died.

sentences.zh: 世淳妾趙、王及臧獲十八人皆死。

translations.literal: Shichun's concubines Zhao and Wang and eighteen servants all died.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun's concubines Zhao and Wang and eighteen servants all died.

sentences.zh: 後贈太仆少卿，建祠，以肇梁祔。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; a shrine was built and Zhaoliang was enshrined with him.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; a shrine was built and Zhaoliang was enshrined with him.

sentences.zh: 隨自十年正月陷，及是再陷，至七月復陷，判官余塙死焉。

translations.literal: Suizhou had fallen in the first month of the tenth year; it fell again on this occasion, and fell once more in the seventh month; Judge Yu Qian died there.
translations.idiomatic: Suizhou had fallen in the first month of the tenth year; it fell again on this occasion, and fell once more in the seventh month; Judge Yu Qian died there.

sentences.zh: 三陷之後，城中幾無孑遺。

translations.literal: After the three falls, scarcely a soul remained in the city.
translations.idiomatic: After the three falls, scarcely a soul remained in the city.
